newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: Abidjan Stock Exchange indices slip slightly.
newsitem.headline: Abidjan Stock Exchange indices slip slightly.

text.p: Ivory Coast's stock exchange indices slipped slightly in the week to Friday on lower turnover, its market report showed.
The report described the decline as technical.
The BVA (Bourse des Valeurs d'Abidjan) index ended the week at 358.99 points, down 0.42 percent on the previous week's 360.49 points, taking the gain for the year to 29.48 percent.
The 12VB 12-share blue chips index fell 0.2 percent from 247.09 points to 246.6 points. The gain for the year is 23.76 percent.
Turnover was lower at 150,077,000 CFA francs from 191,459,000 CFA. A total of 6,446 shares changed hands compared to 9,135.
Notable gainers included SGBCI bank, which added 320 CFA to end the week at 15,650 CFA. Hardware retailer Peyrissac was the main loser, slipping 1,400 CFA to 28,500 CFA.
